mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods ( title, images, price, description, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{goods.title}, #{goods.images}, #{goods.price}, #{goods.description}, #{goods.createTime}, #{goods.updateTime}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET title = #{goods.title}, images = #{goods.images}, price = #{goods.price}, description = #{goods.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_time = #{goods.updateTime} WHERE id = #{goods.id} AND is_deleted = 0
